evidence_summary: EFSA considered haem iron absorption to be approximately 25%.
applicability_notes: Authoritative reference assumption. Not a personalised measured absorption value.

population_description: Adult men at a reference serum ferritin concentration of 30 µg/L
evidence_summary: EFSA used a predicted dietary iron absorption value of 16% for men at serum ferritin 30 µg/L.
applicability_notes: Population-level predicted reference value used for dietary reference modelling. Use as a fallback estimate when more individualised information is unavailable.

population_description: Adult women at a reference serum ferritin concentration of 30 µg/L
evidence_summary: EFSA used a predicted dietary iron absorption value of 18% for women at serum ferritin 30 µg/L.
applicability_notes: Population-level predicted reference value used for dietary reference modelling. Use as a fallback estimate when more individualised information is unavailable.

evidence_summary: EFSA considered 10% to be the best estimate of dietary iron absorption in children up to 11 years.
applicability_notes: Population-level reference estimate; not an individual measured value.

evidence_summary: EFSA used a 16% absorption value for ages 12–17 in the absence of direct dietary absorption data for this age group.
applicability_notes: Extrapolated from adult male data; greater uncertainty than direct age-specific evidence.

population_description: Adults with about 500 mg iron stores (Monsen model assumption)
evidence_summary: Monsen and Balintfy (1982): available non-haem iron % = 3 + 8.93 x ln((EF + 100) / 100) for EF < 75, and 8% for EF >= 75, where EF = g meat/fish/poultry + mg ascorbic acid in the meal. Continuous refinement of the 3/5/8% categories of Monsen et al. (1978).
applicability_notes: Estimates available iron at about 500 mg stores, not measured individual absorption. Equation taken from secondary sources; natural log confirmed by continuity at EF = 75 (3 + 8.93 x ln 1.75 = 8.0). Check against the original paper before setting human_verified.
